prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving forward along a stone pathway flanked by towering red torii gates at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, Japan. The camera steadily advances, capturing the intricate details of the weathered stone steps and the vibrant red pillars that line the path. As the viewer progresses, the surrounding environment becomes more apparent, revealing dense foliage and misty air indicative of a cloudy, foggy night. The camera pans slightly to the left, showcasing a narrow stone staircase leading upwards into the darkness, bordered by a black metal railing. The dim lighting casts an eerie glow, highlighting the textures of the rocks and leaves scattered along the path. The scene transitions to a wider view, where the camera captures a traditional Japanese building partially obscured by trees, its wooden structure blending seamlessly with the natural surroundings. The camera continues to move forward, passing through another set of torii gates, each gate standing tall against the backdrop of the foggy night sky. The atmosphere remains serene and untouched, with no signs of human presence, emphasizing the solitude and tranquility of the location. The camera's smooth movement and subtle shifts in angle provide a comprehensive view of the temple grounds, capturing the essence of this historic site under the cover of night.
